items.text: You look at the sky before school. It is grey and the sun is hidden behind the clouds all day. Which weather word fits best?（　　）。A．sunny　B．snowy　C．cloudy　D．rainy

items.text: Read: 'This morning the sky was full of grey clouds. This afternoon the sun is shining.' How has the weather changed?（　　）。A．It is windier now.　B．It is sunnier now.　C．It is colder now.　D．It is snowier now.
items.answer: B
items.source: 小禾教研原创静态题库 · 样例编写

答：B。
items.hint: 把早上和下午各用一个天气词写下来，再看是往哪个方向变的。
